part: main loop: per-key triage with a false-positive margin
question: How many engine keys meet the tolerance (true-positive rate at least 0.90, false-positive rate at most 0.0025) on held-out halves when the yes-line is fitted at a stricter quota?
one_change: fit each key's yes-line at false-positive quota 0.0010 instead of 0.0025

baseline.model: per-key triage at quota 0.0025: keys meeting the tolerance on held-out halves, share of 328 questions

prediction.metric: tolerance_saving: sum of coverage over keys meeting TPR at least 0.90 and FPR at most 0.0025 on held-out halves, divided by 328
prediction.why: at quota 0.0025 only 16 keys met the tolerance (saving 0.018) because held-out false positives ran at 0.0032 on average; on Function a stricter quota cut the held-out rate by a third for one point of coverage, so most of the 148 keys that miss by a little should pass, at a lower coverage
